mechanism: Furosemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and dehydration may potentiate meprobamate's CNS depression and increase risk of orthostatic hypotension and syncope.
action: Monitor electrolytes, fluid status, and blood pressure regularly; counsel patient on fall precautions and signs of electrolyte imbalance; consider alternative anxiolytic if diuretic use is high-dose or chronic.
